content.outro: The last boat has gone. The landing is quiet until morning.
content.premise: A small stone quay at sundown, after the last ferry has gone. A ferryman, two toll-keepers, a pilgrim and a harbour clerk wait on the landing stage below the quay wall, with a villager and a piglin among them, and two of the drowned dead have come up out of the harbour to stand there too.

content.theme: A small stone harbour quay at sundown: a timber landing stage at the water, a stone quay wall with steps cut up it, bollards and a moored ferry boat, lanterns on posts, and people waiting for a boat that has already gone.
content.title: The Ferry Landing
